basement: Partially finished with bathroom rough-in and large windows
description: Welcome to 14 Sunset Place. Built in 2020, this modern raised bungalow offers a bright, open-concept main living area featuring stylish lighting, contemporary fixtures, quality appliances, sleek cabinetry and a double oven. Thoughtfully designed for privacy, the spacious primary bedroom is located on the north side of the home, while two generously sized bedrooms are positioned on the south end. Set on just under a half-acre lot in a prestigious cul-de-sac, surrounded by mature trees and natural beauty, this property is just a short stroll to the beach, a perfect location for year-round living or as a luxurious cottage retreat. Enjoy added peace of mind with a built-in backup gas generator, ensuring comfort in every season. Step outside to the expansive 24' x 10' covered back porch, an ideal space to relax and take in the breathtaking sunsets, where the sky transforms into the signature pink hues of Lake Huron. The lower level offers incredible potential, with a bathroom rough-in and large windows. It's a blank canvas ready for your vision. Located in the sought-after community of Point Clark, this home appeals to families and retirees alike. Enjoy convenient access to local shops, dining, the beach, and the iconic lighthouse.
locationNotes: Point Clark, Huron-Kinloss. Cross Streets: Huron Rd & Sunset Place. ~15 km south of Kincardine (≈12-15 min drive). Short stroll to Lake Huron beach and lighthouse. Prestigious quiet cul-de-sac surrounded by mature trees.

aiAnalysis.budgetFit: Excellent — $55k under the $950k pre-approval. Leaves comfortable room for closing costs, first-time buyer land transfer tax (with available rebates in Ontario), and any immediate updates.
aiAnalysis.summary: Outstanding alignment with your criteria. 2020 raised bungalow on a private half-acre cul-de-sac in Point Clark — 15 km south of Kincardine and a short walk to Lake Huron beach. Modern finishes, generator, covered sunset porch, and lower-level potential check nearly every box for a first home with room to grow.

23 days on market — ask about motivation and any price flexibility

aiAnalysis.recommendedAction: Schedule a private showing this week. Strongest new-build + lakeside candidate seen so far. Prioritize asking about septic history, utility costs, and any flexibility on price.
